CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS chunks_docs_insert AFTER INSERT ON chunks_docs BEGIN INSERT INTO fts_docs(rowid,chunk_id,path,kind,language,tags,start_line,end_line,text) VALUES(new.id,new.chunk_id,new.path,new.kind,new.language,new.tags,new.start_line,new.end_line,new.text); END
